[Gazette

23rd
January, 2002]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79‑V,
dated 23‑1‑2002.---The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 19th January, 2002, is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short
title and Commencement. ‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Public Safety (Amendment)
Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall
come into fore at once

2. Amendment of section 8 of Regulation
1 of 1947.‑‑‑In the Balochistan
Public Safety Regulation, 1947, hereinafter referred to as the said Regulation,
in subsection (2) of section 8 for the word "District Magistrate" the
words "Provincial Government" shall be substituted.
